channel.title: Verde Talent
channel.description: Renewable energy news and jobs, curated by Verde Talent.

item.title: Brookfield's $600M India renewable platform
item.description: ESG Today — Brookfield Asset Management launched Lumara Energy, a new $600 million India-focused renewable energy platform.

item.title: Ulanqab assigns 4.4 GWh storage buildout
item.description: PV Magazine — Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, has assigned five grid-forming storage projects totaling 4.4 GWh to developers including Datang and China Resources New Energy.

item.title: Samsung SDI's US battery production ramp
item.description: Energy Storage News — Samsung SDI is on track to begin US LFP battery cell production in Q3, and already expects demand to outstrip production.

item.title: Kazakhstan solar capacity tops 1.37 GW
item.description: PV Magazine — Kazakhstan's installed solar capacity has surpassed 1.37 GW, part of a broader renewables push across Central Asia.

item.title: Africa's first battery plant opens in Morocco
item.description: PV Magazine — Morocco is now home to Africa's first battery manufacturing plant — a 10 GWh LFP cell factory from Gotion High-Tech.

item.title: France's first 24/7 renewable supply deal
item.description: PV Magazine — Engie and Legrand signed France's first 24/7 renewable energy supply deal, matching production to hourly demand from 2029 to 2031.

item.title: TotalEnergies acquires Shell's onshore renewables business
item.description: ESG Today — TotalEnergies announced the acquisition of Shell's European onshore renewables business, one of two clean energy deals this week.

item.title: Solar rising at a Texas coal site
item.description: Electrek — One of North America's biggest coal-site solar projects is now under construction in Texas, even as the coal plant next door stays open.

item.title: CATL's storage revenue milestone
item.description: Energy Storage News — CATL's energy storage division made up 19.23% of the battery giant's total revenue in the first half of 2026.

item.title: Ark Energy's AU$1.3B storage buildout
item.description: Energy Storage News — Ark Energy locks in AU$1.3 billion to build a 2.2GWh solar-plus-storage site in New South Wales, Australia.

item.title: 📰 Spain Funds €165M Pumped Storage
item.description: PV Magazine — Spain funded 2 GW of pumped storage — more capacity means more construction and O&M jobs.

item.title: 📰 States Sue Over Wind Power Freeze
item.description: RTO Insider — States are suing over the federal wind power freeze, citing jobs, tax revenue, and public health.

item.title: 📰 Offshore Wind Powers Through Heat Wave
item.description: Canary Media — Offshore wind helped New England's grid survive a record heat wave after proving itself in winter storms.

item.title: 📰 New Energy Career Pipelines Launch
item.description: Renewable Energy World — New workforce coalitions are building direct pipelines from training into hired energy careers.

item.title: 📰 Solar Jobs Surpass 280,000
item.description: Solar Power World — U.S. solar employed 280,000+ workers in 2024 — 460,000+ once storage roles are included.
